test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following are the marks obtained in a test out of 20 by a group of 10 students. Find the mode of the data.

15, 12, 13, 14, 16, 15, 18, 19, 11, 15.
solution:
**Given:**

Marks: 15, 12, 13, 14, 16, 15, 18, 19, 11, 15

**Formula used:**

Mode is the number that appears most frequently in a data set.

**Calculations:**

Frequency of marks:

15 → 3 times

12 → 1 time

13 → 1 time

14 → 1 time

16 → 1 time

18 → 1 time

19 → 1 time

11 → 1 time

⇒ Mode is the number with the highest frequency.

⇒ Mode = 15

**∴ The correct answer is option 4.**
